clauses.title: Scope – Requirements  regarding sizes,materials,
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements  regarding sizes,materials, manufacture and workmanship, and testing of float valves (horizontal plunger type ) for water supply purposes.

clauses.title: Classification –
clauses.text: 2. Classification - a)   High Pressure — High Pressure float valves are indicated by the abbreviation 'HP'and are designed for use on mains having pressure of 0.175 MPa or above. b)  Low Pressure — Low Pressure float  valves are indicated by the abbreviation 'LP', and are designed   for use on mains having a pressure less  than 0.175 MPa.

clauses.title: Nominal Sizes – 5,
clauses.text: 3. Nominal Sizes -  5, 20, 25, 32, 40 and 50 mm. Note — For detailed dimensions, refer to the standard

clauses.title: Materials
clauses.text: 4. Materials TABLE  1 MATERIALS  FOR  BODY  AND COMPONENT PARTS OF FLOAT VALVES SL. NO COMPONENT MATERIAL (1) (2) (3) i) Body and parts of a) Cast Brass fittings (except lever rod and back nut) b) Leaded tin bronze ii) Lever rod Brass rod iii) Back nut and a)  Brass  rod nuts for inlet pipe b)  Leaded tin bronze iv) Washer Synthetic rubber v) Inlet pipe Brass

clauses.title: The inlet shank shall
clauses.text: 5.1 The inlet shank shall be horizontal in case of 15 mm size it may be either horizontal or vertical.

clauses.title: The lever may be
clauses.text: 5.2 The lever may be made in one piece or the short aim and rod may be  seperately constructed.

clauses.title: Hydraulic Test
clauses.text: 6.1 Hydraulic Test —  Every float valve while in closed position shall withstand an internally applied hydraulic pressure of 1.5 MPa for a minimum  period of 2 minutes without leakage or sweating.

clauses.title: Shutting
clauses.text: 6.2 Shutting  Off Test —  Every  'HP' float valve when assembled in working condition with the float immersed to not more than half its volume shall remain closed against  test  pressure of 1.05 MPa and a 'LP' float valve against a test pressure of 0.35 MPa.

clauses.title: Test for Machanical Strength of lever
clauses.text: 6.3 Test for Machanical Strength of lever — Shall be capable  of  supporting the prescribed test loads. +polyethylene  floats (spherical)  for float valves.
